themes.description: Requests for new functionalities, investment options, or enhancements to existing features within the application.
This theme covers feedback related to the availability, display, and selection of various investment products like mutual funds, stocks, or other financial instruments.
This theme covers issues related to downloading, installing, updating, or accessing the application, including compatibility problems with devices or app store availability.
Covers suggestions for improving app navigation, layout, and overall user experience.
Concerns related to account balances, statements, and the integrity or management of specific financial products or features within the account.
Issues or requests related to specific trading tools, indicators, charting functionalities, or feature availability within the platform.
Addresses issues related to the reliability, fairness, and accuracy of order placement, modification, and execution, including price manipulation concerns.
Covers feedback related to existing features, missing features, or requests for new functionalities within the application.
Addresses issues related to order placement, execution reliability, price manipulation concerns, and the fairness of trade processing.
Covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user experience of the application or platform.
This theme covers feedback related to the overall ease of use, interface design, intuitiveness, and general satisfaction with the application's usability.
This theme covers feedback regarding the range of assets supported, the breadth of financial instruments available, and the overall scope and versatility of the platform's offerings.
General feedback on the app's usability, interface, and overall user satisfaction, including positive comments.
Covers issues related to account setup, linking, security features like 2FA, and overall account management.

This theme covers concerns about the overall trustworthiness, integrity, and reliability of the trading platform, including accusations of fraud or issues leading to financial losses not directly tied to glitches or fees.
This theme covers issues related to account creation, verification (KYC), profile updates, and other administrative processes concerning user accounts.
Addresses concerns or feedback related to the growth, returns, or overall performance of investments made through the platform.
Reviews discussing personal financial gains or losses from trading activities, often without attributing it to a specific app malfunction.
General suggestions for improving the application's functionality, adding new features, or expanding existing capabilities.
Requests or feedback related to charting tools, data visualization, and the display of financial information within charts.
Feedback or suggestions related to the application's design, layout, navigation, and overall user experience.

This theme covers concerns related to the trustworthiness, ethical practices, and overall integrity of the platform or service. It includes doubts about fairness or reliability beyond technical issues.

This theme covers feedback related to the application's user interface design, overall user experience, usability, and the presence or absence of specific features. It includes complaints about layout, navigation, and feature functionality.
This theme covers issues related to referral programs, rewards, and incentives.
Support responsiveness, callbacks, issue resolution timelines, and customer service quality.
This theme covers feedback related to the arrangement, sorting, or presentation of data and features within the application interface.
This theme covers concerns related to data security, privacy breaches, unauthorized access, and protection of personal information.
